# Journal

> Journal is an open source notebook (AGPL-3.0) built on Homebase. Notes live on your device first, work offline, and sync encrypted to a space you own. You can share notes with people you know or publish them as public pages, write live Mermaid, SVG, HTML and React blocks inside a note, and let AI agents (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex CLI) read and write the folders you grant through the Journal MCP server.

Journal runs in the browser at {{SITE}}/welcome and signs in with a Homebase identity. Journal in the browser is free, with every feature. The native apps for desktop, iPhone and Android are a free download with a 3-day trial, then a one-time purchase (€24.99) that includes a year of updates and works on every platform.

## Pages

- [Home]({{SITE}}/): what Journal is, where notes live, the editor, sharing and public pages, live blocks, and common questions
- [Agents]({{SITE}}/landing/agents): set up the Journal MCP server in Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor or Codex CLI step by step (sign in, approve, grant folders, check, fixes for common errors), and the reference for all fourteen tools: what each does, its inputs with types, what it returns, when to use it and an example request
- [Pricing]({{SITE}}/landing/pricing): the free web app, the paid native apps, and questions about paying
- [Buy]({{SITE}}/landing/buy): buy or renew the native-app license for a Homebase identity

## Docs

- [MCP server README](https://github.com/2002Bishwajeet/journal/blob/main/mcp/README.md): setup for each client, headless sign-in, and every tool
- [Authoring guide](https://github.com/2002Bishwajeet/journal/blob/main/mcp/AUTHORING.md): everything a note can hold and how to write it, including live blocks
